ticker_eras.reason: Terra's original LUNA traded as LUNA until the May 2022 collapse; it is now Terra Classic (LUNC, CMC 4172). Terra 2.0 (CMC 20314, added 2022-05-26, genesis 2022-05-28) took the LUNA ticker, often on the same exchange instrument.
TerraUSD traded as UST until the May 2022 collapse; exchanges renamed it USTC (TerraClassicUSD, CMC 7129).

venue_tickers.reason: Paxos renamed PAX to Pax Dollar (USDP) in August 2021 and Binance relisted its PAX pairs as USDP on 2021-09-10. Gate's USDP is the unrelated USDP Stablecoin (CMC 8886), which other venues' evidence would otherwise lend Binance.
OKX delisted its PAX pairs on 2022-04-12 and listed Pax Dollar as USDP on 2022-04-20, after Paxos renamed PAX to USDP. Not the USDP Stablecoin (CMC 8886) that Gate lists.
